prTitle: fix(NXENG-762): name the header brand graphic, and hide the unnamed vendor SVG
finding: AC-3 says the header exposes exactly one named brand image, but this loop only checks that each SVG has some qualifying ancestor. Two duplicated wrappers, each containing a hidden mark, satisfy every assertion while expo
whyMissed: AC-3 is a cardinality claim — exactly one exposed named image — and the test was written as a per-graphic loop, which can only ever say 'each graphic has some named ancestor'.
